WHAT: Web app that takes a fashion photo (Pinterest, Instagram screenshot) and finds similar items available on Vinted in the user's size, with direct buy links.
HOW IT WORKS: AI identifies clothing items → searches Vinted unofficial API → returns visually similar listings filtered by size and price.
API DETAILS: Vinted has an unofficial internal API at /api/v2/catalog/items. Returns: id, title, price, total_item_price, service_fee, brand_title, url, photo, user, favourite_count, view_count. Single item at /api/v2/items/{id} gives brand_id, size_id, status_id, description, color, condition. Undocumented — Vinted can change or block anytime.
PROJECT: /Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/vinted-fashion-finder/
STATUS: Started. Blocker: needs Google Cloud project + auth keys for Vision API (AI image recognition). Ned knows the steps but can't initiate.
